designationHistory.indexText: President Harry S. Truman established the Tennessee National Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 9670 on December 28, 1945 on Tennessee Valley Authority lands along Kentucky Lake.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record; fws.gov page) and Pass B (order text on the American Presidency Project) agree. The order followed a November 29, 1945 agreement between the Tennessee Valley Authority and the Interior Department.
